manifest.title: Dependency-Track
manifest.author: OWASP Dependency-Track Contributors
manifest.description:
Dependency-Track is an intelligent Component Analysis platform that allows organizations to identify and reduce risk in the software supply chain. It ingests CycloneDX SBOMs and tracks every component across all projects and versions.

### Features

* Finds known vulnerabilities from NVD, GitHub Advisories, OSV and others
* Flags outdated components by checking npm, PyPI, Packagist, Maven, Go and more
* Policy engine for security, license and operational rules
* License risk tracking
* REST API for CI/CD integration
manifest.changelog:
* Initial version with Dependency-Track 5.2.0
* Cloudron login via OIDC, Cloudron groups map to Dependency-Track teams
* Email notifications through the Cloudron mail server

change-default-password.message: Log in with `admin` / `admin` (under **More options** on the login page) and set a new password

manifest.postInstallMessage:
Log in with username `admin` and password `admin`. You are asked to set a new password on first login.

<sso>
The local login form is under **More options** on the login page.

Cloudron users are created on first login without any permissions. To grant access, create a team under **Administration → Access Management → Teams** and map it to a Cloudron group under **OpenID Connect Groups**. Group membership is synchronized on every login.
</sso>

The first vulnerability database download takes several minutes after install.
